Good Thai in Saigon
Jun 2018 • Friends
Went with a friend who had been recommending this place. Knowing Saigon doesn’t really provide good Thai food I was a bit skeptical. Turned out to be a nice surprise. We shared 2 sets lunch (available until the 30th of June). Basil stir fried chicken and red curry beef, with steamed rice. Both dishes were advertised as very spicy. Flavor and taste wise, I found the food quite authentic. They even had sugar, dried chilly flakes and vinegar marinated cut chilly on the side you can add to your taste... just like in restaurants in Thailand.

Inconsistent quality
Feb 2018 • Friends
To be fair, I've been to Thai Street in D2 and it was great. I absolutely love the experience. The food (especially the fried chicken wings) was super yummy. You could always ask for more or less spicy, they can customize. However, my first time at Thai Street D1 was a disappointment. 

We ordered:
- fried chicken wrapped in pandan leaves
- pad thai
- som tum pou (spicy papaya salad with pickled crab)
- yum woon sen (glass noodles with pork and seafood)
- and their special fried chicken wing on another menu

None was up to expectation. The fried chicken with pandan leaves was a bit too dry and tasteless. My favorite fried chicken wing was still soaked with oil. I wouldn't recommend the other 3 dishes either...Maybe the main chef was still not back from his Tet holiday...hence the unexpected food quality...

However, I do recommend this place for its decoration and rooftop atmosphere. Some more work on the food quality would be appreciated. For now, it isn't worth my money ($10-$15/person for dinner)

Great set lunch!
Jan 2018 • Couples
Great second location in the city centre. Lovely rooftop spot, with indoor and outdoor seating available. Unfortunately it looks out onto the current building work happening throughout the city - but beyond that you get the Bitexco tower.

Had a vegetarian green curry and massaman curry and they were both delicious. Very big portion! Choice of sticky or normal rice and a small side of morning glory.

Mango sticky rice for dessert was just the right size to finish off a lovely meal.
 
You also get a soft drink or tea in with the deal.

For 120,000vnd you definitely can't go wrong!

Great Thai with Great View
Jan 2018 • Couples
The atmosphere is wonderful. It's highly recommended to visit at night.
Yet are there not many skyscrapers in HCMC but it has some cool view from which you feel the vividness of Saigon. 
They also have a shop in Thao dien, but I enjoyed this one more due to its atmosphere.
Small set back is that they are newly open so the waitresses are friendly but not yet trained; several times I had to call out for them loudly even though there weren't many customers. 

I tried their curry, coconut soup with chicken, Singha beers and mango with sticky rice. 
Very genuine Thai dishes.This place is located within walking distance from Benh Thanh Market and Saigon Square.
